# WO-2026-08-18-07 — The board the human sees, and the lane that must not die silently
# guidance: WO-YYYY-MM-DD-nn — slice title

## Acceptance criteria

> **Read the receipt first:** `Builds/BUILD-015-.../Assurance/veritas-phase-agentic-runtime-gate2-4bc0894.md`.
> **Verdict HOLD, requirement 8 FAIL.** Veritas's own summary of why it is HOLD and not FAIL: *"The route
> is now correct… What is absent is production execution."* **You fixed the decision path. This order
> fixes what the human touches and what happens when the lane dies.**

**AC1 — THE BOARD IS BUILT FROM THE DECISION. (Requirement 8, the FAIL row.)** Every open question and
every candidate on it must trace to the model's own output. Today the board carries the scorer's
leftovers — *"Gourmet Mon Petit Intense Cod, Sardine, Salmon Wet Cat Food"* offered as the **only**
option for `1 wet wipes`. **Provable by construction, not by inspection:** it must be structurally
impossible for a candidate the model did not produce to reach a card.

**AC2 — A TAP CANNOT OVERRIDE THE MODEL ON A LINE THE MODEL RESOLVED.** `applyDecisionsToPlan` runs
**after** `decideBasket`, so a tap on the cat food binds and the model cannot overturn it. **Warwick's
recorded decisions must still outrank the model where he genuinely decided** — that is settled and is
not being reversed. What must not survive is a tap on a candidate **the model would have refused**
silently becoming the answer. Establish the correct precedence and prove both directions.

**AC3 — STALE BOARDS. Nothing regenerates an existing board when the decision changes.** Shop 37's
seven questions are the artefact of a superseded generator and will still be there when the next real
photograph arrives. Decide and implement what happens to a board whose decision has been re-made —
regenerate, supersede, or explicitly close — and **say which you chose and why**. Do not leave a
condemned artefact live because the code that made it was fixed.

**AC4 — THE LANE MUST NOT DIE ON THE FIRST ATTEMPT.** `consume-request.cjs:166-172` calls
`lease.finish(status:'failed')` on the **first** `basket_not_ready`, with no retry, no backoff, no
re-queue, and overwrites `progress` — discarding the Gap-7 executor progress. **A configuration
failure is not a permanent failure.** Give it the same bounded-retry treatment the attempt ceiling
already provides, and stop it discarding progress.

**AC5 — ⛔ AND IT MUST NOT BE SILENT.** `runtime.js:2847` binds `announce` to a **log line only** — no
outbox row was written and **nothing reached the human** when four requests died tonight. **Prove the
notification is EMITTED**, not that a log line exists. This is the `failure must never be silent`
clause of the estate's own completion bar, and a test asserting a log write does not satisfy it.

**AC6 — `CONFIGURATION.md` DISAGREES WITH THE LAUNCHER.** It documents `ASDAIR_CHROME_EXE` and
`ASDAIR_CDP_ENDPOINT` (the latter marked ADVISORY) for a lane whose launcher requires
`ASDAIR_CHROME_PATH`, `ASDAIR_CHROME_PROFILE_DIR` and `ASDAIR_CDP_PORT` as **blocking with no
defaults**. `RUNBOOK.md` is correct. **Correct `CONFIGURATION.md` to match the code.** Do NOT write any
env file — the values are Larry's to place with Warwick's authority.

**AC7 — NOTHING ALREADY WORKING MOVES.** The decision path, the contract digest, the manifest join, the
attempt ceiling, and the 37/37 interpret measurement all stay green.

1. **READ-BACK FIRST, then HOLD.** Your last two read-backs each found a real defect in my framing.

3. AC4 + AC5 together — a bounded retry whose exhaustion nobody hears is not an improvement.

5. **Git:** `C:/Fusion247PKA-agentic` on `build-015/agentic-decision-path`. Commit, push, no PR.
6. **Evidence for Veritas.** Its stated discharge condition is one real photograph through the joined

7. **Warwick is not to be returned to** except for a genuinely Warwick-only decision or credential
